title: Concept: Indirect requirement written by hand
description: go.mod declares a `require` entry marked `// indirect` in the module file, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `require` entry marked `// indirect` in the module file.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `require` entry marked `// indirect` in the module file.
